set -e; cat > /app/galaxy_portal.py <<'PY'
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, shutil, subprocess

ROOT = Path('/app/galaxy-portal')
RUN = Path('/app/galaxy-run')

def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest()

def token_ok(header, record):
    path = ROOT / record
    return path.exists() and header.startswith('Token ') and digest(header[6:]) == path.read_text().strip()

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def reply(self, code, data):
        body = json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_POST(self):
        auth = self.headers.get('Authorization', '')
        length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', '0'))
        body = self.rfile.read(length)
        if self.path != '/api/v3/artifacts/' or not token_ok(auth, 'publisher.sha256'):
            self.reply(403, {'decision': 'deny'})
            return
        artifact = RUN / 'acme.demo-1.0.0.tar.gz'
        sig = RUN / 'acme.demo-1.0.0.sig'
        pub = RUN / 'collection-signing.pub'
        check = subprocess.run(['openssl', 'dgst', '-sha256', '-verify', str(pub), '-signature', str(sig), str(artifact)], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
        if check.returncode or body.decode() != hashlib.sha256(artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest():
            self.reply(400, {'decision': 'invalid'})
            return
        shutil.copyfile(artifact, ROOT / 'acme.demo-1.0.0.tar.gz')
        (ROOT / 'published.json').write_text(json.dumps({'namespace': 'acme.demo', 'revision': '1.0.0', 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}, sort_keys=True))
        self.reply(201, {'namespace': 'acme.demo', 'revision': '1.0.0'})

    def do_GET(self):
        auth = self.headers.get('Authorization', '')
        if self.path == '/api/v3/artifacts/latest' and token_ok(auth, 'reviewer.sha256') and (ROOT / 'published.json').exists():
            self.reply(200, json.loads((ROOT / 'published.json').read_text()))
        elif self.path == '/api/v3/token-scope' and token_ok(auth, 'publisher.sha256'):
            self.reply(200, {'identity': 'release-publisher', 'scope': 'collection:publish'})
        elif self.path == '/api/v3/roles/release-publisher' and token_ok(auth, 'reviewer.sha256'):
            principal, namespace, capability = (ROOT / 'namespace-role.txt').read_text().strip().split('|')
            self.reply(200, {'principal': principal, 'namespace': namespace, 'capability': capability})
        else:
            self.reply(403, {'decision': 'deny'})

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        return
